newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swap -Regrade widens, buyers dominate.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swap -Regrade widens, buyers dominate.

text.p: Singapore swaps regrade continued to widen as buyers took centre stage amid perception that physical demand for jet fuel will remain stronger than gas oil, traders said on Wednesday.
But a number of traders said they did not believe that the market is very strong. "I think it has been overdone," one trader said.
They said the firmer tone on jet fuel values was mainly due to Indonesia's July and August requirements amid the shutdowns during those two months at the Balikpapan and Cilacap refineries.
July swaps regrade was bid at $2.00 per barrel, up 40 cents from morning levels, while August was bid at $1.75, up 15 cents from this morning.
Sellers were staying away in anticipation of better values, traders said.
They said the jet/gas oil spread on the prompt month is around $2.25 per barrel, which set the tone for swaps regrade values.
Taiwan has awarded its jet fuel import tender to a western trader at around $197 per tonne for August 1-10 delivery, cost-and-freight basis.
This worked out to around $23.80 per barrel, free-on-board Singapore basis, which is at a discount level to current Singapore spot quotes.
Gas oil swaps rose marginally by late afternoon but most players remained comfortable with present levels.
July swaps were quoted at $22.30/$22.40 per barrel, August at $22.70/$22.90 and September at $23.25/$23.50, all barely unchanged from Tuesday's levels.
On Tuesday, the lowest traded level for July swaps was $22.22 and the highest at $22.40, while August was traded between $22.80 and $22.88 per barrel.
Physical buyers took cover when sellers tried to offer at more than $22.00 on Monday, underlining the fact that current values are limited to the $21.50-$21.90 range, traders said.
Fuel oil also rose slightly from morning levels as buyers were expected to emerge on the physical market.
July swaps were quoted at $99.75/$100.50 per tonne and August at $99.00/$100.25.
